originalTitle: How men with female surnames are standing up to ridicule in Kenya
title: Brave Boys and Their Special Names in Kenya!
content:
Hello from Sunny Africa!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly news reporter here, coming to you from beautiful Africa! We have so many interesting stories to share with you. Today, we are going to talk about names. Do you know your name? Of course, you do! Everyone has a name, and names are very special.

What is a Surname?

You have a first name, like 'Lily' or 'Tom'. Then you have another name, your family name. We call it a surname. It's like a special team name for your family! For example, maybe your first name is 'Sam' and your surname is 'Kamau'. So you are Sam Kamau. Usually, children get their dad's surname. It’s a very old way of doing things. It helps us know which family you belong to. My surname is also from my dad! **Did you know?** Surnames help us trace our family tree! It's like a map of all the people in your family, going back many, many years!

Names from Mums and Grandmums

Sometimes, things are a little different. In Kenya, which is a wonderful country in Africa, some children get their mum's surname. Or even their grandma's surname! This can happen for many reasons. Maybe their mum was super brave, or maybe it’s a very old family tradition from their mum's side. Imagine a boy whose surname is 'Akinyi'. 'Akinyi' is usually a girl's first name in some parts of Kenya. So, it's a bit like a boy having the surname 'Rose'! It's just a name, right? But it can make people wonder. This is not a very common thing. Most boys usually have a surname that people expect for a boy. But times are changing! Families are finding new ways to pick names. **Did you know?** Kenya has many different tribes, and each tribe has its own beautiful names and traditions! One name can mean different things to different people.

Why Names Can Be Tricky

Sometimes, when boys have a surname that sounds like a girl's name, other kids might tease them. Teasing means making fun of someone. It's not a nice thing to do. Imagine someone laughing at your name. How would that make you feel? It would make you feel sad or a little bit angry. These boys are just like any other boys! They love to play, learn, and have fun. Their surname doesn't change who they are inside. But when people tease them, it can make them feel shy or like they are different in a bad way. No one wants to feel like that. **Did you know?** Many famous people around the world have unique names! What matters most is what you do with your life, not just your name.

Being Brave and Standing Tall

But guess what? These boys are very brave! They are standing up for themselves. Standing up means being strong and telling people that it's not okay to tease. They are showing everyone that their names are special, no matter what. They are saying, "My name is part of my family history, and I am proud of it!" They are teaching others that a name is just a name. It doesn't tell you if someone is a boy or a girl. It tells you about their family. This is a very important lesson for all of us. We should respect everyone’s name. A name is a gift. **Did you know?** When you are kind to others, it makes you feel happy too! Being kind is like a superpower.

Families are Special

Families are changing all the time. Some families have two parents, some have one parent, some live with grandparents. And now, some families are changing how they share their surnames too! It’s all part of how life grows and changes. What is most important in a family? Love! And kindness! And making sure everyone feels safe and happy. A surname is just one tiny piece of a big, wonderful family puzzle. It doesn’t change the love. These boys and their families are showing everyone that it's okay to be different. It’s okay to have a special name. It makes the world more interesting! **Did you know?** There are over 1.4 billion people in Africa! That's a lot of different names and families!

Let's Be Kind

So, next time you meet someone, remember to be kind. Ask them their name and listen carefully. Don’t tease anyone for their name, or for anything else! Everyone deserves respect. These brave boys in Kenya are helping us all learn this lesson. They are showing us that our names are part of our story, and every story is important. Let's celebrate all the wonderful names in Africa and around the world! Yay for kindness and special names!
summary: Some boys in Kenya have surnames that sound like girls' names, and they are bravely standing up to teasing and showing everyone that all names are special.
whyMatters: This is important because it teaches us to be kind and respectful to everyone, no matter what their name is, and to celebrate how every family is unique and special.

originalTitle: 'We should all be excited' - Messi set for first England meeting
title: Super Messi's First Big Game Against England!
content:
Hello, my amazing young football fans across Africa! Get ready for some super exciting news from the world of football! Imagine the best football player you know, a true superstar with a magic touch. His name is Lionel Messi!

Meet Our Football Hero, Lionel Messi!

Lionel Messi is like a wizard with a football. He comes from a country far, far away called Argentina. When he runs with the ball, it's like he has glue on his boots! He can dribble past many players, and he scores the most amazing goals. Lots of kids, just like you, dream of playing football like Messi! He inspires so many of us to kick a ball and have fun. He shows us what can happen when you work hard and love what you do!

What is the World Cup?

Now, let's talk about something super special called the World Cup. It's like the biggest, most fun football party in the whole wide world! Every four years, countries send their very best football teams to play against each other. They all want to win the shiny golden trophy! It's a time when everyone watches football and cheers for their favourite teams. It brings people together, just like a big family gathering!

Argentina's Amazing Journey

Messi plays for his country, Argentina. Their team wears lovely blue and white stripes. They are a very strong team! In the World Cup, they had to play many other good teams. One of their recent games was against a team called Switzerland. It was a very exciting game! Both teams tried their best, running and kicking the ball with all their might. Argentina played with great teamwork and skill. Argentina won that game against Switzerland! Hooray for Messi and his fantastic team! This win was super important. It meant they got to go to the next stage of the World Cup. This stage is called the "quarter-finals." It's like reaching a very important level in a video game – you are getting closer and closer to the final boss! Only the best teams make it this far.

A Brand New Challenge: Playing England!

Now, listen to this super exciting news! After winning against Switzerland, Messi and his Argentina team are going to play against *another* very, very strong team. This team is called England! England is another famous football country, and they have some fantastic players too. They are known for playing tough and never giving up. It will be a real test for Argentina!

Did you know?

Did you know that football is the most popular sport in the whole wide world? More people watch and play football than any other sport! You can find a football game happening almost anywhere, from big stadiums to small dusty fields in your village!

Why This Match is Super Duper Special!

This game between Argentina and England is going to be incredibly special, my friends. Do you know why? Because Lionel Messi has *never, ever* played against England before! Can you believe it? This will be his very first time facing them on the football pitch. It's like waiting to see your favourite superhero fight a new supervillain for the first time! Everyone, young and old, is talking about it. It's a really big deal in the football world. People are excited to see how Messi's amazing skills will match up against England's strong team play. Will he score magical goals? Will he make incredible passes? We will all have to wait and see!

What to Expect from the Game

This match will be super fast and full of energy. Both Argentina and England really, really want to win. They will run so much, tackle carefully, and try to get the ball into the net. There will be lots of cheering and clapping from the fans watching. Imagine the roar of the crowd when a goal is scored! It's an amazing sound! The players will play with all their heart.

Did you know?

Did you know that Messi is sometimes called 'La Pulga'? That means 'The Flea' in English! They call him that because he is small and super quick, just like a little flea, making it hard for other players to catch him!

The Spirit of Football

Football is not just about winning or losing. It's about teamwork, trying your best, and having fun. It's about respecting other players and learning to play fair. When you play football with your friends, you learn to share, to work together, and to cheer each other on. This big game between Argentina and England will show us all these wonderful things about football. Even though it's a tough competition, at the end of the day, all the players are there because they love the game. And we, the fans, love to watch them play! It inspires us to be active and chase our own dreams, whether it's playing football or something else.

Get Ready to Cheer!

So, get ready to cheer, my young friends! Find your favourite team colours, maybe even kick a ball around with your friends before the big game. The whole world will be watching Lionel Messi play England for the very first time. It's going to be an unforgettable game, full of magic moments and incredible football! Let's celebrate the beautiful game of football together!

Did you know?

Did you know that the World Cup trophy is made of real gold? It's very shiny and heavy! Only the winning team gets to lift it high above their heads. What a prize!

One Last Thing!

Remember, football is for everyone! Girls and boys, big kids and small kids, everyone can enjoy playing or watching this wonderful sport. It teaches us about being strong, being smart, and being part of a team. So let's get excited for Messi's big match!
summary: Lionel Messi, a famous football player from Argentina, will play against England for the very first time in a super exciting World Cup match after his team beat Switzerland.
whyMatters: This match is important because it's a big, first-time event for a superstar player like Messi, showing how exciting football can be and inspiring many young children across Africa and the world to love the game and teamwork.
